pages.text: Tadpoles are the bridge between $(l:zen_amphibia:genetics/frogspawn)frogspawn$(/l) and adult frogs. Their genome is already present, so a tadpole is a future member of the $(l:zen_amphibia:genetics/breeding_goals)breeding line$(/l).
Good ponds matter. A cramped puddle may hatch tadpoles, but it will not raise them as well as a larger wetland. Watch for signs of $(l:zen_amphibia:lifecycle/overcrowding)overcrowded water$(/l).
